extension.description: Reviews the hidden experimental `upctl all purge` command, which can delete resources throughout the currently selected UpCloud account, disable termination protection during cleanup, and retry non-404 deletion errors. `upctl all list` remains outside this extension rule. This is an opt-in HOL-authored integration, not an UpCloud-supported plugin.
extension.name: UpCloud upctl purge command protection

permissions.description: Requires local review for `upctl all purge` including filtered forms. The command can force-delete UpCloud resources, clear termination protection, and retry until the calling CI job times out.
permissions.label: Purge UpCloud account resources
safer_guidance: Use `upctl all list` with matching filters to preview targets.
Prefer a dedicated test account, and protect production resources by policy before proceeding.

rules.description: Requires local review for `upctl all purge` including filtered forms. The command can force-delete UpCloud resources, clear termination protection, and retry until the calling CI job times out.
safer_alternatives: Use `upctl all list` with matching filters to preview targets.
Prefer a dedicated test account, and protect production resources by policy before proceeding.
rules.title: Purge UpCloud account resources

safer_alternatives: Inspect the selected account and filters with `upctl all list` before any purge.
Scope cleanup with `--include` and `--exclude` and consider a dedicated nonproduction UpCloud account.
